item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 22/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and visibility will be relatively low over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, temperatures over the coast of southern China will fall slightly midweek next week. A broad band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week.
